evidence.title: Suriname alleges racist abuse in Guatemala, calls on FIFA and Concacaf to act

occurrences.checkable_against: Richonell Margaret's Instagram account and archived story
occurrences.quote_span: Margaret shared a number of racist comments and images sent to him on Instagram and posted an Instagram story directed to Concacaf and FIFA: "The entire stadium is making monkey noises at me and my teammates. Do we always have to accept this?"
occurrences.speaker: Richonell Margaret
occurrences.subject: Suriname-Guatemala Concacaf Nations League match

occurrences.checkable_against: Match video, official match timeline and referee report
occurrences.quote_span: The red card started a delay of nearly 10 minutes, as Suriname spoke with referee Joe Dickerson, who could be seen making the "X" — FIFA's no-racism gesture, during the conversation with Suriname captain Myenty Abena.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Suriname-Guatemala Concacaf Nations League match

occurrences.checkable_against: Myenty Abena's Instagram post
occurrences.quote_span: "As captain, I was faced with a difficult decision: Do we walk off the pitch and accept the consequences, or do we continue with 10 men and refuse to let racism drive us away from the game we love?" Abena wrote in a lengthy Instagram post after the game.
occurrences.speaker: Myenty Abena
occurrences.subject: Suriname-Guatemala Concacaf Nations League match

occurrences.checkable_against: Myenty Abena's Instagram post
occurrences.quote_span: "With around 20 minutes left, we chose to continue. Not because what happened was acceptable. Not because it didn’t affect us. But because of our love for football, our country, and each other."
occurrences.speaker: Myenty Abena
occurrences.subject: Suriname-Guatemala Concacaf Nations League match

occurrences.checkable_against: Match footage, team delegations and match official reports
occurrences.quote_span: Suriname general manager Brian Tevreden was on the touchline during both matches and spoke with Dickerson during the delay on Monday.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Suriname-Guatemala Concacaf Nations League match

occurrences.checkable_against: Official Concacaf Nations League match result and match report
occurrences.quote_span: Guatemala went on to win 1-0 on a stoppage-time winner from California-born Matthew Evans.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Suriname-Guatemala Concacaf Nations League match

occurrences.checkable_against: Brian Tevreden's statement to USA TODAY Sports
occurrences.quote_span: "I am seriously considering no longer traveling with my team to places where this is allowed to happen. Concacaf and FIFA really have to take action now."
occurrences.speaker: Brian Tevreden
occurrences.subject: Suriname-Guatemala Concacaf Nations League match

occurrences.checkable_against: Richonell Margaret's post-match comments or recording
occurrences.quote_span: Margaret said after the game that "the entire stadium" was making monkey noises toward him.
occurrences.speaker: Richonell Margaret
occurrences.subject: Suriname-Guatemala Concacaf Nations League match

occurrences.checkable_against: Henk Fraser's post-match news conference
occurrences.quote_span: "My players also can’t react to that, that’s also not the right thing to do, but this is something that [should] never happen in such a beautiful country as Guatemala."
occurrences.speaker: Henk Fraser
occurrences.subject: Suriname-Guatemala Concacaf Nations League match

occurrences.checkable_against: USA TODAY's request-for-comment correspondence with FIFA
occurrences.quote_span: FIFA did not immediately return a request for comment..
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Suriname-Guatemala Concacaf Nations League match

occurrences.checkable_against: Henk Fraser's post-match news conference
occurrences.quote_span: "That is a pity," Fraser said. "It cost us a game, and I think if it’s FIFA, Concacaf, whatever, they really have to stop these stupid things."
occurrences.speaker: Henk Fraser
occurrences.subject: Suriname-Guatemala Concacaf Nations League match

occurrences.checkable_against: Henk Fraser's post-match news conference
occurrences.quote_span: "To be honest, the reason why we got the red card is because one of my players reacted to some people who made noises which are not decent to do," Fraser said in a post-match news conference.
occurrences.speaker: Henk Fraser
occurrences.subject: Suriname-Guatemala Concacaf Nations League match

occurrences.checkable_against: Official match report and referee disciplinary record for Guatemala-Suriname on 2026-10-05
occurrences.quote_span: In the 63rd minute of the match in Guatemala City, Suriname forward Richonell Margaret was shown a direct red card for what appeared to be a comment made toward a fan.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Suriname-Guatemala Concacaf Nations League match

occurrences.checkable_against: Suriname national team statement and Concacaf Nations League match records
occurrences.quote_span: The Suriname national team has called on Concacaf and FIFA to investigate incidents of racist abuse from fans they say players were subject to during a Concacaf Nations League match against Guatemala on Monday, Oct. 5.
occurrences.speaker: Suriname national team
occurrences.subject: Suriname-Guatemala Concacaf Nations League match

occurrences.checkable_against: Brian Tevreden's statement and records of Suriname's Central American matches
occurrences.quote_span: "And beyond tonight, it's already the second time this has happened to us in Central America. It's disgraceful."
occurrences.speaker: Brian Tevreden
occurrences.subject: Suriname-Guatemala Concacaf Nations League match
